name: dobe_rub4d
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind, rubbing its muscular chest up and down against the person it hugs: the torso stretches up like soft goo lifting the shoulders and head high, then squashes down low, a big slow vertical stroke, while its waist and lower body stay fixed in place on the pillar. No sideways movement, eyes hidden, sticky goo strands, looping
